mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_webhook_subscription(owner_type, owner_id, channel_id, name, url, url_host, events_json, status, deleted, revision, key_version, secret_sha256, secret_prefix, secret_cipher, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES ('CLUB', #{ownerId}, #{channelId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{urlHost}, #{eventsJson}, #{status}, 0, 1, 1, #{secretSha256}, #{secretPrefix}, #{secretCipher}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_webhook_subscription WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_webhook_subscription SET name = #{name}, events_json = #{eventsJson}, status = #{status}, url = #{url}, url_host = #{urlHost}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE im_webhook_subscription SET deleted = 1, status = 0, revision = revision + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.owner_id AS ownerId, s.channel_id AS channelId, s.events_json AS eventsJson FROM im_channel ch JOIN im_webhook_subscription s ON s.channel_id = ch.id AND s.owner_type = 'CLUB' AND s.owner_id = ch.guild_id WHERE ch.id = #{conversationId} AND ch.guild_kind = 1 AND (ch.legacy_conversation_id = ch.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_conversation cv WHERE cv.id = ch.id AND cv.type = 5)) AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_webhook_delivery(subscription_id, event_id, event_type, state, attempt, reason, payload_json, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{subscriptionId}, #{eventId}, #{eventType}, 'PENDING', 0, #{reason}, #{payloadJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_webhook_delivery WHERE id = #{id} AND subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_webhook_delivery SET state = 'PENDING', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_until = NULL, reason = 'RETRY_REQUESTED', attempt = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = #{expectedState} AND attempt = #{expectedAttempt}
mapper.select: (SELECT id, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, state, attempt FROM im_webhook_delivery WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, state, attempt FROM im_webhook_delivery WHERE state = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_retry_at, id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, state, attempt FROM im_webhook_delivery WHERE state = 'INFLIGHT' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit})
mapper.update: UPDATE im_webhook_delivery SET state = 'INFLIGHT', attempt = attempt + 1, last_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL (#{leaseMs} * 1000) MICROSECOND, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = #{expectedState} AND attempt = #{expectedAttempt}

UPDATE im_webhook_delivery SET state = #{state}, reason = #{reason}, http_status = #{httpStatus}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, response_snippet = #{responseSnippet}, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL (#{nextRetryMs} * 1000) MICROSECONDNULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'INFLIGHT' AND attempt = #{attempt}
